title: PipeshubContextCompactedEvent
description: The conversation's context was compacted. trigger user: the person asked (`/compact [focus]`, SLASH2 C2), and the run that took the request did it before its first turn: the durable loop journals its summary as `context.compacted` and then this; an engine run compacts its own session (Codex `thread/compact/start`, opencode `summarize`, Claude Code's own compaction) and journals this with the turn. trigger auto (LC2FIX-3): nobody asked; the durable loop's ladder compacted when the provider counted a request past its threshold (journaled after its `context.compacted`), or an engine compacted its own session mid-turn (Claude Code's compact_boundary, opencode's session.compacted, Codex's contextCompaction), journaled with the turn. Token counts: before is the provider's count of the latest request where the executor has one (else an estimate), after that less what the summary removed; an engine's as it reports them; null when unknown. Written only when the claim's journal accepts `context_compacted` (trigger user) or `context_compacted_auto` (trigger auto). Presentation and audit only (non-critical); folds ignore it.

trigger.description: Who asked: user, the person with /compact; auto, nobody (the loop's ladder or the engine's own compaction).

executor.description: What compacted: the durable loop, or the engine the run is pinned to (an ACP agent profile's acp-<agent> included).

outcome.description: compacted: the context is smaller now; nothing_to_compact: nothing is older than what is always kept; unsupported: the engine cannot compact on request; failed: the compaction was tried and did not complete (the run goes on uncompacted).

beforeTokens.description: Estimated context tokens before; null when unknown.

afterTokens.description: Estimated context tokens after; null when unknown.

userMessagesKept.description: The person's own messages are kept word for word after the summary (the loop, Codex); false: the engine folds them into its summary.

focus.description: What the person asked the summary to keep (`/compact <focus>`).
